summary: Iteration 20 FRONTEND-ONLY graphics overhaul verification (Playwright, viewport 390x844, demo@empirelords.com). GREEN with one minor UX/testID note. Flows verified: (1) LOGIN → worlds → world-enter-world_1 → /map: map-3d-view renders after ~9s WebGL warmup — screenshot shows the new storybook look: bright green rolling terrain, dense round-canopy tree clumps, blue sky, own castles with red conical rooftops (Casa Demo L10 at 6,188 + Casa Demo · 5,183) and label chips floating above them — no black/blank canvas (canvas 390x744 present). (2) MAP zoom-out + map-center-pyramid-button → after ~6s screenshot shows the Pyramid monument (tan stepped pyramid with flags & lanterns) on bright green grass surrounded by round trees; label 'Piramide [DEMO] 5g 2h' correctly rendered (1 occurrence). map-zoom-in/-out and map-rotate-button all responsive. (3) MAP settlement selection: tapping map-settlement-chip-stl_0484bd7cfcbd40dd does NOT open the selection card (0 map-selection-* testIDs appear). Tapping map-label-stl_0484bd7cfcbd40dd DOES open it — 6 testIDs present: map-selection-card, map-selection-crest, map-selection-name, map-selection-close, map-selection-open-city, map-selection-battles. Card correctly shows 'Casa Demo · [DEMO] Tuo · L10 · Foresta (+10%) · 6,188 · 0 tile', a 'Città' quick action and recent battle history (5 wins). NOTE: no `map-selection-caravan` testID observed for own home settlement — only open-city + battles. (4) CITTÀ tab: settlement-village renders (living 3D village panel) — storybook look OK. (5) settlement-village-expand → /city: city-screen + city-title = 'Casa Demo' ✓; after 6s the CityScene canvas renders with sky dome; a center tap at (195,420) opens city-picked with city-picked-name = 'Castello / Fortezza' ✓; city-picked-close hides the card ✓; upward mouse-drag (195,560 → 260,420) tilts the camera without crash; city-back returns to Città cleanly. (6) /skins: castle 3D preview canvas renders — storybook castle (red conical rooftops on grey fieldstone base, green grass disc) — 4 skin cards visible (Classico In uso, Arenaria, Regale, Ossidiana locked) + Applica button. (7) /house: house-march-skin-preview element present (count=1). (8) CONSOLE: 13 console entries total, ZERO errors/PageErrors after whitelist filter (textShadow/shadow*/pointerEvents/GPU stall/ReadPixels/toNonIndexed) — no red-screen, no exceptions across the whole run.
